neighbours.label: 'present' in 'present-day' and 'so' in 'so-called': a word marking the following name as current or merely alleged
fire: The trading post stood near present-day Denver.
Critics mocked the so-called miracle diet.
The battle took place in what is now present-day Belgium.
Nobody trusted the so-called experts on television.
The tribe once lived along present day Lake Erie.
He called it a so-called reform that changed nothing.
Ancient roads ran through present-day Turkey and Syria.
The so-called golden age of radio ended in the fifties.
quiet: The trading post stood near the city of Denver.
Critics mocked the new miracle diet.
All the students were present for the exam in Belgium.
Nobody trusted the experts, so they asked a friend.
The tribe once lived along the shore of Lake Erie.
He said the reform was so slow that it changed nothing.
Ancient roads ran through the hills of Turkey and Syria.
She wrapped the birthday present in golden paper.

notes: top: ' so' x11 (so-called), ' present' x8 (present day). Probes: 'so cold' and 'the present situation' stay low.
